All persons interested in the aforesaid parcels on which a Land is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Galewela Divisional Secretariat on the 15th August 2024 at 10.00 a.m., and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 08th August 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
